{{Short description|Mathematical theorem}}
In [[mathematics]], '''Shafarevich's theorem''' states that any [[finite group|finite]] [[solvable group]] is the [[Galois group]] of some [[finite extension]] of the [[rational number]]s. It was first [[mathematical proof|proved]] by {{harvs|txt|last=Shafarevich|first=Igor|authorlink=Igor Shafarevich|year=1954}}, though [[Alexander Schmidt (mathematician)|Alexander Schmidt]] later pointed out a gap in the proof, which was fixed by {{harvs|txt|last=Shafarevich|year=1989}}.
